label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) to 83 (21 Aug) to 91 (23 Aug) to 100 (24 Aug) to 103 (25 Aug) to 105 (26 Aug) to 111 (27 Aug), then held flat on 28 Aug (Day 14) with no new fatalities reported. BNPB says many recent additions were indirect earthquake impacts (shock, falls, aftershock-triggered cardiac events) or hospitalized victims who could not be saved, rather than fresh structural-collapse fatalities.

label: Injured
contestNote: BNPB's 27 August tally cites 1,672 injured, up slightly from 1,666 (25 Aug); the injured count has swung both up and down across reporting days as regency-level tallies are reconciled.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Displacement fell for the first time since the quake: from a peak of 185,131 (25 Aug) to 179,037 (26 Aug) to 176,621 (27 Aug), driven by the steepest drop in Sikka Regency as families returned home or moved into more permanent shelter. Nagekeo remains the regency with the most displaced residents at 51,284.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: BNPB's 27 August verified tally of 77,912 (24,597 severe, 18,537 moderate, 34,778 slight) is up from 73,818 (24 Aug); East Manggarai now has the most severely damaged homes (6,833). Figures remain preliminary pending completion of by-name-by-address verification.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: M1.1–M6.2 range; 7,029+ recorded by 25 August, passing 8,193 by 27 August (146 felt by residents). BMKG's forecast of continued activity for 21–30 more days from the mainshock is unchanged.

label: Presidential Visit Status
deltaNote: Twice-postponed visit finally took place on Day 11 (26 Aug); Prabowo distributed Rp200 billion in aid at a Nagekeo Regency command post.

label: Personnel Deployed
delta: 5,832 TNI + 238 Polri + 903 volunteers as of 22-23 Aug (up from 3,500+ TNI/Polri on 17 Aug)

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.

label: Schools Damaged
contestNote: 92% of the education-sector assessment complete as of 21 August: 5,521 classrooms damaged, 502 school buildings severely damaged, affecting 177,678 students and 21,166 teachers/staff.
